ingested.license: MIT (mirror repository). Provenance caveat: the upstream Lipi repository carries no LICENSE file and the official ICIT channel is scholar-access only; this layer is used for internal research pooling only and is NOT redistributed.
ingested.name: ICIT inscriptions via Lipi repository export, MIT mirror by field-cady
ingested.numbering: Wells/ICIT sign numbers; converted to Mahadevan M-numbers via data/crosswalks/canonical_sign_registry.csv (Wells->M direct, else Wells->Parpola->M via crosswalk v2)
ingested.source_chain: ICIT (Fuls & Wells, A.11) + Mahadevan (A.1) -> Lipi repository CSV exports (yajnadevam/lipi) -> field-cady/indus_valley_script_corpus (GitHub, MIT License)
ingested.correction: Continuation audit 2026-10-05: the first layer build indexed the Holdat flat token list instead of inscription sequences, so its seen-set held per-sign character tuples and Holdat dedupe never fired (only intra-ICIT dedupe did; reported as 1008 inscriptions / 2241 tokens). phase107_build_layers.py was fixed to index Holdat inscription sequences (1399 distinct sequences, len>=3) and the layer rebuilt BEFORE this log was first committed: 1007 inscriptions / 2238 tokens (exactly 1 inscription, 3 tokens, was a Holdat duplicate). Build-time dedupe is vs Holdat + intra-layer; dedupe vs the CISI subset happens in phase107_corpus_pool.py at pooling time, so no pooled result was ever affected.

ingested.name: CISI Mohenjo-daro subset (in-repo, re-verified against upstream)
ingested.note: Full upstream repo re-downloaded 2026-10-05 (corpora/downloads/mayig_indus_valley/): its corpus/ directory contains exactly the same 179 inscriptions already in-repo; no additional sites. Conversion to M-numbers is performed by backend/scripts/phase107_corpus_pool.py via crosswalk v2 inversion.
ingested.source_chain: CISI vols. (Parpola et al.) -> mayig/indus-valley-script-corpus (GitHub, MIT) -> in-repo backend/glossa_lab/data/indus_cisi_corpus.json (ingested 2026-04)

acquisition.scope: Systematic hunt for public Indus source corpora not previously ingested, per Tristen's 2026-10-05 addition to Step 4. Public download links only; nothing behind access controls was scraped. Downloads live under corpora/downloads/ (gitignored per repo convention); converted layers are separately flagged.
